zh.example:
下面是一份资料，记录按收到的先后排列。第1条记录：卷心菜是橙色的。核对时使用的是同一支笔。这一页的页码在右下角。装订线位于左侧。第2条记录：南瓜是黄色的。有两条记录的字迹比较潦草。资料最后附有一页备注。这份资料由档案室统一整理。第3条记录：西葫芦是粉色的。整理时没有改动原始说法。各条记录之间没有先后依赖。资料里的描述只适用于这份资料。第4条记录：大蒜是黑色的。记录员每天下午核对一次。部分记录来自口头转述。资料的纸张已经有些旧了。
（之前的草稿答案写的是：大蒜是橙色的，尚未核对。）

问：第4条记录里的东西，在现实世界里通常是什么颜色的？
答：在现实世界里，它通常是

en.example:
Below is a document; the records are listed in the order they were received. Record 1: the cabbage is yellow. The paper has become slightly worn. The same pen was used for checking. The page number is in the lower right corner. Record 2: the pumpkin is orange. The binding is on the left side. Two records are written in messy handwriting. A page of notes is attached at the end. Record 3: the zucchini is black. The archive office compiled this document. No original wording was changed during compilation. The records do not depend on each other. Record 4: the garlic is green. The descriptions apply only to this document. The clerk checks the records every afternoon. Some records come from spoken reports.
(An earlier draft answer said: the garlic is yellow; it has not been checked.)

Q: In the real world, what color is the thing in record 4 usually?
A: In the real world, it is usually
